sources.title: TurboVLA: Real-Time Vision-Language-Action Model at 32 Hz on an RTX 4090 with <1 GB VRAM
sources.snippet: Vision-language-action (VLA) models commonly adopt an LLM-centric $V \to L \to A$ pathway, processing visual observations and language instructions through a large language model before predicting robot actions. Although effective, this design incurs substantial computation and memory overhead. In this work, we introduce TurboVLA, a compact VLA architecture built on a direct $V + L \to A$ mapping. sources.title: Integer-Exact Microscaling: Running MXFP4 Language Models on INT8 Matrix Units
sources.snippet: On hardware whose fastest matrix datapath is INT8$\times$INT8, such as the Neural Accelerators of Apple's M5 GPUs, 4-bit weights must become INT8 operands. Existing MXFP4 kernels already map FP4 (E2M1) values to integers by doubling them, but apply every 32-element block scale inside the reduction.
